members.member: Raytrace once on playback, then remove the emitter. Recommended for short sounds.
The number of reverb rays to cast.
The maximum number of bounces per reverb ray. Reverb rays stop bouncing after reaching the edge of the world when the world's "is indoors" setting is false.
The percentage of returning energy required for reverb to be at maximum volume.
The loudest volume that this emitter's sound will ever be played at.
How long, in milliseconds, the echogram records data for. Returning reverb rays after this period are ignored.
The length, in milliseconds, of each entry in the echogram.
If [code]true[/code], this emitter's EAX is blended into the world's Grouped EAX. Should be [code]false[/code] for listener emitters.
If [code]true[/code], this emitter is used as a reference point for calculating relative reverb gain and direction. Should be [code]true[/code] for your main listener emitter.
The lower bound of the relative reverb blend range.
The upper bound of the relative reverb blend range.
If [code]true[/code], this emitter's reverb send uses the listener's reverb effect rather than its own.
The number of occlusion rays to cast.
The maximum number of bounces per occlusion ray. Occlusion rays stop bouncing after they discover all targets.
The percentage of occlusion energy required for a target emitter to be at full volume.
The number of permeation rays to cast.
The number of bounces per permeation ray.
The percentage of permeation energy required for a target emitter to be at full volume.
The number of ambient occlusion rays to cast.
The maximum number of bounces per ambient occlusion ray. Ambient occlusion rays stop bouncing after reaching the edge of the world.
The percentage of ambient occlusion energy required for ambience to be at full volume.
The number of ambient permeation rays to cast.
The number of bounces per ambient permeation ray.
The percentage of ambient permeation energy required for ambience to be at full volume.
The number of visualisation rays to cast.
The number of bounces per visualisation ray.
The interval, in milliseconds, between visualisation ray updates.
A user-defined integer tag for categorising emitters.

The number of trails that are rebuilt from scratch each frame, to prevent staleness when the emitter moves. Trails are only rebuilt if the initial bounce position has strayed too far from the new bounce position.

The distance threshold for recreating trails, to prevent staleness when the emitter moves. Trails are only rebuilt once the initial bounce position has strayed further than this from the new bounce position.
The seed used to randomise scattering vectors. Randomised per emitter by default.
If [code]true[/code], keeps this emitter's position inside the world bounds.
If [code]true[/code], renders each trail a different color in the debug window (dev build only).
The color of ray trails in the debug window (dev build only).
The color of reverb rays in the debug window (dev build only).
The color of occlusion rays in the debug window (dev build only).
The color of permeation rays in the debug window (dev build only).
The color of ambient permeation rays in the debug window (dev build only).
